item.title: Blood and the Dance
item.description: Have you ever heard of those spirit quest, a journey that a man must take in order to reach adulthood in accordance with tradition to some native American tribes? Blood and Dance explores this with a unique duality and modernism that hasn’t been seen. Two men experience this journey in subtle ways the reader would never imagine. Author: David R. Waters Publisher: ScribbCrib Publishing Language: English Word Count: 71000 Preview Blood and the Dance

item.title: A School for Murder
item.description: Necromancy. Not quite the career choice people would follow, but some are willing to die for it. School for Murder is a unique twist on the detective genre, laced with dark humor, as it follows the life of one such detective necromancer who works with the spirits of the dead to put criminals to justice. But an interesting plot has risen, involving organ stealing, and a bit of dark magic. Can the detective find the source before it’s too late? The sequel to The Keenest Blade. Author: Laura Morten

item.title: A Noble Man’s Death
item.description: Christopher waits in his jail cell as his day in the gallows approaches. With visits from his son, Edward, and other important people in his life, he reconciles the crimes he committed, his reasons for killing the prince and facing the end of his days. Author: Matthew Anderson Publisher: ScribbCrib Publishing Language: English Word Count: 8500 Preview A Noble Man’s Death

item.title: A Little Off the Top
item.description: Clyde, a down on his luck barber lives in a world where most people work and are productive members of society, while others choose to drink, smoke, and do drugs while contributing nothing. A barber by trade, and a productive member of society, Clyde’s hobbies inter-mesh with the dregs of the world and crosses into a dark path. Author: Steven York Publisher: ScribbCrib Publishing Language: English Word Count: 6200 Preview A Little off the Top

item.title: The Land of Erinna
item.description: Driven underground by a poisoned sun, civilization is forced to adapt and thrive beneath the surface. Humanity tries to rebuild the society that was lost to the skies. Twelve years into their new lives, an outsider enters and places everyone in danger. Wielding a sword and leaving death in his wake, a militarized police force that protects this new civilization must rise up against this man. Who is he? Why is he here? And what does he plan to do next? Author: Alex Virault Publisher: ScribbCrib P

item.title: A Thief in the Night
item.description: Shard is a young half-elf making her way through the world of Fallenkirk with the two skills she knows best: thievery and seduction. Charged with stealing a precious gem for her employer, Shard runs into unexpected trouble in the form of a handsome man and a promise of something more. Does she dare challenge him and give in to temptation, or find another way out of her plight before she ends up on the hangman’s noose? Author: Megan Sharpe Publisher: ScribbCrib Publishing Language: English Word C

item.title: Dark Obsession
item.description: A hunt is under way. Evangeline, Eva, and her fellow vampires are living on borrowed time and must do whatever it takes to find a route to the new world. As they travel across the country-side of Northern England, Eva becomes mesmerized by a human man, forcing her to make a decision that could tear her world asunder. Ensnared in a battle between her heart and survival, will she allow love to to consume her? Author: Karen Graham Publisher: ScribbCrib Publishing Language: English Word Count: 5600
